1 Analysis setup

37/37 requested genes found among RefSeq Select transcripts All requested genes were found.

Organism/reference: Mus musculus, RefSeq GCF_000001635.27 (GRCm39). Transcript coordinates use RefSeq Select records (annotation read from genomic.refseq_select_mrna.gff).

Requested gene panel: 37 symbols (Spic, Nfe2l2, Blvra, Hmox1, Vcam1, Slc40a1, Gsr, Slc7a11, Gclc, Cat, Gpx4, Gclm, Gss, Txnrd1, Fth1, Nfs1, Cisd1, Aifm2, Acsl4, Acsl1, Lpcat3, G6pdx, Pgd, Me1, Idh1, Nox1, Elovl7, Ido1, Alas1, Dhodh, Acsl3, Scd1, Bach1, Nqo1, Slc48a1, Mafg, Sqstm1); 37 found. All requested symbols were found among RefSeq Select records.

Genes in this scan: 37 (Spic, Nfe2l2, Blvra, Hmox1, Vcam1, Slc40a1, Gsr, Slc7a11, Gclc, Cat, Gpx4, Gclm, Gss, Txnrd1, Fth1, Nfs1, Cisd1, Aifm2, Acsl4, Acsl1, Lpcat3, G6pdx, Pgd, Me1, Idh1, Nox1, Elovl7, Ido1, Alas1, Dhodh, Acsl3, Scd1, Bach1, Nqo1, Slc48a1, Mafg, Sqstm1).

TF motif matrices: Spic (M03221_3.10), Nfe2l2_1 (M09222_3.10), Bach1 (M10181_3.10). PWMs are loaded from the local Mus musculus CIS-BP collection (Mus_musculus_2026_09_17_11_49_am_CISBP) and scanned with RSAT.

Promoter window: -5,000 bp upstream to +200 bp downstream of the TSS (strand-aware).

Site threshold: P < 0.0001; background model: order-1 Markov model estimated from the promoters included in this scan.
